inventory.gap_count_method: Count all entries in `.records[].gaps[]` from a fresh `npm run --silent data:gaps` report.
inventory.gap_count_discrepancy: B119 changed no catalog records, but the fresh raw report contains one more entry than the prior scope ledger. Preserve both figures and investigate the measurement discrepancy separately.

scope.research_boundary: Inspect each exact attempt and its accepted source records first. For volatile price and route fields, check one current exact-model source where accessible. Use exact manufacturer/brand evidence for model specifications. Stop at decisive evidence; retain unresolved build, generation, market, selection, measurement or rights caveats. One Luna Max reader may report evidence only; the primary writer integrates it.
excluded: No fields outside the ten frozen queue targets.
No personal or private data; no login, CAPTCHA, bypass, or broad scrape.
Do not download or host third-party images without documented reusable rights.
Do not infer material, build, option, price or model relationships from adjacent records.
